name: T-Express
description: One of the greatest wooden roller coasters ever built — T-Express is a legendary hybrid wooden coaster that consistently ranks among the top five roller coasters in the world. Delivering a record-breaking 77-degree drop, incredible airtime and relentless intensity through a spectacular layout that makes every ride a genuinely extraordinary experience. The crown jewel of Everland and a must-ride for any coaster enthusiast visiting Asia. Min 140cm.

name: Gyro Drop
description: One of the tallest and most terrifying free-fall drop towers in the world — Gyro Drop rises 70 metres above Everland and releases riders in a breathtaking free fall with panoramic views over the Korean countryside. A Guinness World Record holder and one of the most iconic thrill attractions in Asia. Min 140cm.

name: Rolling X-Train
description: A wildly intense inverted roller coaster delivering 4 inversions and high-speed swooping turns — Rolling X-Train is one of the most popular thrill coasters at Everland and delivers a relentlessly exciting ride experience that keeps riders coming back for more. Min 135cm.

name: Double Rock Spin
description: A thrilling double-sided spinning coaster that delivers rapidly alternating forward and backward launches through an intense layout — Double Rock Spin is one of the most disorientating and exciting coaster experiences at Everland. Min 120cm.

name: Crazy Mouse
description: A wildly spinning wild mouse coaster delivering sharp unexpected turns, sudden drops and intense spinning that makes every ride completely unpredictable — one of the most fun and rerideable coasters at Everland. Min 120cm.

name: Thunder Falls
description: A spectacular log flume ride through dramatic waterfall landscapes delivering a soaking final plunge — Thunder Falls is the most popular water ride at Everland and an essential experience on hot Korean summer days. Min 110cm.

name: Amazon Express
description: A thrilling river rapids ride through a dramatic Amazon jungle environment — Amazon Express sends riders spinning down raging rapids with dramatic waterfall effects and guaranteed soakings. The most exciting white-water ride in Korea. Min 110cm.

name: Safari World
description: The most spectacular drive-through safari experience at any theme park in Asia — Safari World takes guests on a guided tour through a vast naturalistic environment where lions, tigers, bears, giraffes and dozens of other exotic animals roam freely alongside the safari vehicles. One of the most extraordinary and unique wildlife experiences available at any theme park worldwide. Suitable for all ages.

name: Panda World
description: An extraordinary giant panda habitat at Everland — home to resident giant pandas in a beautifully designed naturalistic environment. Panda World is one of the only places in Korea where visitors can see giant pandas and one of the most popular wildlife experiences in the country. Suitable for all ages.

name: Caribbean Bay
description: Korea's largest and most spectacular outdoor water park — Caribbean Bay is a separate water park within the Everland resort featuring massive wave pools, elaborate themed water slides, lazy rivers and a fully equipped spa facility. One of the most complete and impressive water parks in Asia. Separate admission required. Min 110cm for slides.

name: Caribbean Bay Water Slides
description: The spectacular water slide complex at Caribbean Bay featuring speed slides, family raft slides, the thrilling Master Blaster uphill water coaster and the iconic Mega Storm funnel slide — the most comprehensive and exciting water slide collection in Korea. Min 110cm.

name: Tulip Garden
description: Everland's breathtaking tulip garden is one of the most spectacular floral displays in Korea — each spring the park is transformed by millions of tulips in hundreds of varieties creating an extraordinary seasonal experience that draws visitors from across Asia. Suitable for all ages.

name: Global Fair Zone
description: The entertainment and culture hub of Everland — Global Fair features elaborate themed street environments representing different world cultures, live entertainment stages, street performers and the most vibrant and atmospheric zone in the park. Suitable for all ages.
